exchanges: hiii ok i need distraction im sitting in the hospital waiting room
Sorry you're stuck there. Happy to keep you company, what's going on?
my nephew jun fell off his scooter, hes fine mostly just waiting on xrays
Glad he's mostly okay. Waiting for x-rays always takes forever.
ya my sister lin is with him in the back. shes a dietitian at this same hospital lol so she knows everyone
That must make things a little easier, knowing the staff.
kinda yeah. ok distract me tell me something
Sure. Want to tell me about your week, or should I throw out a random topic?
lol my week was chaos. my brother wei bought a mustang. a MUSTANG. hes 42
A midlife sports car, classic. Is he enjoying it?
he loves it his wife does not lmao
That sounds like a very familiar story.
and meanwhile my dad has gotten super into birdwatching since he retired, he bought binoculars that cost more than my rent
Retirement hobbies can get serious fast. At least it gets him outside.
he sends me blurry pics of like sparrows every morning
That's sweet, even if the photos aren't great.
it is sweet ngl
Sounds like he's really happy.
ok so my neighbour mrs kowalski. she's like 80 and she adopted a cat and its name is pierogi which i love
That's a great name for a cat.
her husband is a retired plumber and he fixes everyone's stuff on the street for free
Every street needs one of those.
honestly yes he fixed my sink twice
That's a good neighbour.
ugh still no update on jun
Hang in there. No news usually just means they're busy, not that anything's wrong.
ok lin just texted they're doing the xray now
Good, things are moving.
my brother in law daniel is on his way to pick up lin's car since she came in the ambulance with jun
Nice that he can help with the car.
he finally ditched that awful old van, he's got a prius now so at least he wont be stuck at the gas station
A hybrid makes a lot of sense for everyday driving.
lol and him and wei argue about cars at every family dinner
The sports car versus the hybrid, I can picture it.
its so dumb
Family dinner debates are half the fun, though.
true. oh i forgot mrs kowalski's cat isnt pierogi, pierogi was the one that died last year, the new one is kluski. i got confused
Ah, that makes sense, easy to mix up when she's had both.
she talks about both all the time so
Understandable.
my mom is learning spanish on duolingo for a trip and keeps texting me in broken spanish
That's fun. Where's the trip?
mexico in march with her book club
That sounds like a great trip.
shes so excited
Having something to look forward to helps.
ok i'm getting a coffee from the vending machine
Good call, waiting rooms are draining.
it tastes like burnt dirt
Vending machine coffee is reliably bad.
lol
Any word from your sister yet?
not yet
Hopefully soon.
ok update the doctor says jun broke his wrist, small fracture, so a cast for six weeks
Poor kid, but a small fracture heals well at his age.
he's already asking if everyone can sign it
That's a good sign he's in decent spirits.
ya hes fine lol hes more excited than upset
Kids bounce back quick. Hope you all get home soon.

questions.message: whats my brother in law driving these days
what's dad's new retirement thing again
mrs kowalski's cat is kluski now yeah
what does wei do for work
im so ready to go home and sleep
